verdict.rationale: An error tracker could plausibly ship built-in AI root-cause analysis, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no native GlitchTip AI that analyzes stack traces, breadcrumbs and commits to propose a root cause. Its built-in MCP server only lets external AI assistants pull issue data, which is a building block rather than the platform's own analysis. The detect_n_plus_one tool is an adjacent pattern detector, not root-cause analysis.
